renderer: Fusion Design workspace shaded viewport with masked lighting and fastener compositing; not ray traced

post_processing.method: Masked raster compositing on the native Fusion capture; no generative image used in the final asset.
post_processing.lighting: Warm-white eyes, eight connected rainbow mouth zones with feathered transitions and no separator lines, and softly blended cyan/blue/lavender/mint body illumination. Glow is illustrative, not an optical simulation.

fasteners.finish: Black hex-socket heads with raised crowns and contact shadows

post_processing.preserved: Original camera, framing, mouth aperture, CAD part geometry and alpha channel. CAD and print files are unchanged.
post_processing.revision_update: R33 recapture with the same camera and settings registers with the R29 base (identical framing and alpha bounds); only the former rectangular foam shoulder window changed visibly. Edits were carried over pixel by pixel: unedited pixels take the new capture, edited pixels keep their light as a screen layer, and the newly visible foam joins the body mask with the neighbouring body color and the body-shade formula. Fasteners, eyes and mouth are unchanged. The R29 base is main-front.png at git 8a72de2896cdb1b682f472856744d0cf4435149e.

homepage_animation.source: The same Fusion capture and diffuser masks used for the still image. The base retains the accepted raised screw heads, with the animated lenses and nearby glow restored before compositing.
homepage_animation.behavior: Eight rainbow mouth zones form one horizontal audio-level meter with restrained random pulse heights about every 620 ms, a gentle 120 ms attack and 850 ms release, soft leading edge and a 48% background glow. Six broad body color pools drift slowly. Warm eye lights blink with a fast close and slower reopening at irregular intervals.
homepage_animation.limits: Decorative simulated audio level; no microphone or device connection. Illustrative lighting, not an optical simulation. Camera, aperture, silhouette and hardware geometry are unchanged.
homepage_animation.glow: Normalized separable Gaussian canvas compositing, shared across browsers without requiring CanvasRenderingContext2D.filter. Glow opacity stays in the supported 0–1 range; eye glow follows blink openness.
